note: Quirk lines for camp at different hours and on festival days, by quirk category. Read by core/overhaul/quirkTimes.ts.

rest.morning: {Name} stretches slowly and wishes the morning were longer.
rest.evening: {Name} is already looking for the softest spot to settle.
rest.night: {Name} is out cold the moment the fire settles.
rest.festival: {Name} sleeps through the first half of the festival and wakes up for the cake.

weather.morning: {Name} sniffs the sky to see what the day will bring.
weather.evening: {Name} watches the clouds go gold and approves.
weather.night: {Name} peeks out at the weather every few minutes, just to be sure.
weather.festival: {Name} insists the weather is festival weather, whatever it is.

collection.morning: {Name} checks that every treasure is still where it was left.
collection.evening: {Name} lines up its finds in the firelight.
collection.night: {Name} sleeps with one paw on the best find of the day.
collection.festival: {Name} brings out the finest treasure to show at the festival.

food.morning: {Name} is first in line for breakfast and stays there.
food.evening: {Name} sniffs every pot twice, just to be fair.
food.night: {Name} dreams of dinner and drools a little.
food.festival: {Name} makes a beeline for the festival food stalls.

battle.morning: {Name} runs a few quiet drills before the others wake up.
battle.evening: {Name} replays the day's fights in its head.
battle.night: {Name} keeps one eye open, ready for anything.
battle.festival: {Name} sets the fighting aside for the day, almost.

social.morning: {Name} greets everyone one by one, as if it were their birthday.
social.evening: {Name} shuffles in close, so no one is left out of the circle.
social.night: {Name} settles down beside whoever seems lonely.
social.festival: {Name} dances through the festival and drags everyone along.

time.morning: {Name} has been up for hours, or hasn't gone to bed at all.
time.evening: {Name} perks up exactly as the light fades.
time.night: {Name} comes alive in the dark and keeps the watch happily.
time.festival: {Name} loses all track of time and is perfectly happy about it.

legendary.morning: {Name} stares at the horizon a little too long.
legendary.evening: {Name} watches the sky as if something might answer.
legendary.night: {Name} whispers to the stars and listens for the reply.
legendary.festival: {Name} stands quietly at the edge of the lights, glad to be here.

vanity.morning: {Name} spends the whole morning on its look, and it shows.
vanity.evening: {Name} catches its reflection in the water and nods.
vanity.night: {Name} fusses over its best angle by the firelight.
vanity.festival: {Name} outdoes itself for the festival and expects applause.

exploration.morning: {Name} is gone before breakfast and returns with dirt on its nose.
exploration.evening: {Name} has found a new path and cannot wait to show you.
exploration.night: {Name} sits at the edge of the light, wondering what is out there.
exploration.festival: {Name} wanders the festival and finds the best corner first.

luck.morning: {Name} finds something shiny in the dew and decides it is a good day.
luck.evening: {Name} flips a pebble for luck and it lands just right.
luck.night: {Name} tucks its lucky find under its head and sleeps well.
luck.festival: {Name} wins a festival game by pure accident and acts like it planned it.

storytelling.morning: {Name} is already scribbling the first notes of today's story.
storytelling.evening: {Name} gathers everyone close and clears its throat for a tale.
storytelling.night: {Name} tells a story by the fire, and the fire seems to listen.
storytelling.festival: {Name} is the star of the festival, telling the tallest tale of all.
